content:
Fifteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records covering Sunday night, October 25, through Monday night, October 26, 2026. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

OZORNIA, RAUL

OZORNIA, RAUL was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 11:46 p.m. on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member. Bond was set at $5,000; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

RAMIREZ, CECILIA JANETH

RAMIREZ, CECILIA JANETH was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 1:33 a.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of harassment. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

BOUQUET, BRYAN

BOUQUET, BRYAN was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 5:42 a.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of criminal trespass. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

CONTRERAS, FRANCISCO

CONTRERAS, FRANCISCO was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 6:28 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of terroristic threat of family or household. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

CRUZ, FATIMA FABIOLA

CRUZ, FATIMA FABIOLA was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 8:46 a.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated. Bond was set at $5,000; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

VALDEZ-ANICENTO, ANTOLIN

VALDEZ-ANICENTO, ANTOLIN was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 10:05 a.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on alleged charges of resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor, and failure to identify by giving false or fictitious information, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000 on each charge; the person is also being held on an out-of-county and immigration hold.

RUBIO, MANUEL EDUARDO

RUBIO, MANUEL EDUARDO was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 10:14 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of violation of a bond or protective order. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

SARAVIA-TABORA, JIRETH ALEXANDRA

SARAVIA-TABORA, JIRETH ALEXANDRA was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 10:21 a.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated. Bond was set at $2,000; the person is also being held on an immigration and out-of-county hold.

GARCIA-ORTIZ, BALTAZAR ISMAEL

GARCIA-ORTIZ, BALTAZAR ISMAEL was booked on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 12:12 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held by the United States Marshals and Customs and Border Protection.

LEDEZMA, MIGUEL ANGEL

LEDEZMA, MIGUEL ANGEL was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 2:15 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated. Bond was set at $2,000; the person is also being held on an out-of-county hold, and the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

REYES, ALEJANDRO

REYES, ALEJANDRO was booked on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 2:31 p.m. on an alleged parole violation hold. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held by the Texas Department of Criminal Justice.

PEREZ, ORLANDO

PEREZ, ORLANDO was booked on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 3:09 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held by the United States Marshals.

GARZA, ROLANDO ARNOLDO

GARZA, ROLANDO ARNOLDO was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 4:31 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of interference with public duties. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

MEJIA, ABRAN

MEJIA, ABRAN was booked on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 5:36 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held by the United States Marshals.

CASTELLANOS REYES, DURVIN ONEL

CASTELLANOS REYES, DURVIN ONEL was arrested on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 11:02 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of cruelty to a non-livestock animal, listed as failure to provide. Bond was set at $1,500.

title: Police Blotter: 15 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
